IMF approves fourth review of Sri Lanka bailout

The International Monetary Fund approved the fourth review of Sri Lanka's extended fund facility on Tuesday, releasing about 344 million US dollars to the country, officials said in Colombo.

The Central Bank of Sri Lanka said the disbursement would strengthen gross official reserves, which have recovered strongly since the 2022 economic crisis when the country defaulted on its foreign debt.

Analysts said continued revenue reforms and a stable exchange rate would be needed to keep the programme on track through the next review, expected in six months.
